computation: Select records inside the declared segment region, discard records whose speed is unavailable, and take the minimum of the remaining values.
definition: The lowest normalized speed observed among the records that fall inside the declared segment region on one experimental unit.
limitations: A higher minimum speed is not automatically faster overall; it says nothing about entry, exit, or lap time.
The value depends entirely on the declared segment region and cannot be compared across different regions.
Records whose speed is unavailable are excluded and counted as attrition; they are never read as zero.
name: Segment minimum speed
